Repograde: agent summary
========================

WHAT: Zero-dependency CLI (Node >=18.17) that grades public GitHub repos
before they are announced: 33 checks across docs, community, engineering,
discoverability, release hygiene and agent-readiness.

RUN: npx -p github:fastpresspages/repograde repograde owner/repo
     Add -o report for report.html/json/md + badge.svg + fix-plan.md.

CATEGORIES (weights): docs 20, community 15, engineering 25, discoverability 15,
release 10, agent 15. Check ids look like docs.readme, eng.ci, agent.instructions.

SCORING: pass=1 warn=0.5 fail=0, category normalized, overall weighted by
category weights, letter grade A+..F. Skipped/info leave the pool.

LIMITS: public metadata only; 60 req/h unauth, 5000/h with GITHUB_TOKEN;
heuristic, not a security audit; never writes to the repo.

ALSO SHIPS: MCP server (stdio, grade_repo/list_checks), GitHub Action, and an
installable agent skill at skills/repograde/SKILL.md
(npx skills add fastpresspages/repograde).

SAMPLE: fastpresspages/launchgrade scored A+ 96/100 on 24 Oct 2026
(samples/launchgrade/). fastpress-start scored B 79/100 the same day.

LICENSE: Apache-2.0. No telemetry, no ads, no fake metrics.
